fusions.name: Sticky Tendril
fusions.desc: Flicks a sticky tendril at one enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, more the further it reaches, up to 1.5 times. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulrush Spring
fusions.desc: You spring up and land in the reeds, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking each back 3 tiles and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Algal Jelly
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a jelly of algae that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Stem
fusions.desc: When your stamina becomes full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
